verdict.rationale: Bento documents attaching user_id, session_id, and arbitrary tags (feature flags, experiment IDs) to every span, and separately reports cost per run out of the box. However, no evidence shows cost or usage being aggregated or broken down by those user, session, or feature dimensions. Missing for 10: documented cost and usage rollups by user, session, or feature tag; token and usage attribution views; independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can attribute cost and usage to users, sessions, and features via custom metadata

citations.quote: `init()` accepts `user_id`, `session_id`, and `tags` kwargs. Bento invokes them on every span
Tag spans with experiment IDs, feature flags, anything.
you see cost per run, tool failure rates, drift over prompt versions, and regressions across deploys out of the box.
pass the same `convo_id` on every call and Bento ties the runs together for you.
